name: SetCommunicationOrphanGrace
pure_preflight: show current pending-orphan count and rule that existing due times are not silently rewritten
transaction_boundary: one LLD-01 UnitOfWork through LLD02 SettingDefinitionRegistry
receipt_order: replay -> revalidate -> insert command_receipt -> setting write -> audit/results -> commit
revision_effects: new value affects orphan intervals created after commit; already-pending purge due times remain bound to the accepted event/config snapshot unless separately governed correction is added
